adp.meaning_of_absence: No qualifying satellite detection. Does NOT mean there is no haze or smoke.

spark.scene: Frame is almost entirely black fill with only a narrow band of white to light-gray ordinary clouds visible along the northern top edge; no islands, ocean detail, or discolored haze streaks indicative of a plume are visible, including around the expected island locations in the southern portion.

classify.caveats: No plume found; nothing to classify.

kilauea.activity_summary: The Halema'uma'u eruption of Kīlauea remains paused following episode 55 on October 17. The forecast for episode 56 fountaining is now Nov. 3-10, 2026.

mauna_loa.activity_summary: Mauna Loa earthquake counts decreased in September compared to August, and minor inflation continues. Mauna Loa had a decrease in seismic activity compared to the previous month; a total of 53 earthquakes were detected in Mauna Loa's summit region during the September reporting period, after 87 in August. Most earthquakes occurred deep beneath the upper Southwest Rift Zone or broadly scattered around the upper flanks.
